title: Late Estimate Write-Up and Free Storage: a Repair Estimates & Appointments Service Standard
content:
**Standard.** A late write-up lengthens the free storage period of a Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement. The write-up lateness is the calendar days from the check-in date to the estimate written date less the estimate type's turnaround business days (2 for the Blueprint Teardown Estimate, 3 for the Structural Blueprint Estimate).

- A write-up lateness of at least **4** days adds **3** free storage days.
- A write-up lateness of at least **2** days but under **4** days adds **1** free storage day.
- A smaller write-up lateness adds none.

**Both sides of each threshold**

| Write-up lateness (days) | Free storage days added |
|---|---|
| 1 or less | none |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 1 |
| 4 | 3 |
| 5 or more | 3 |

**Worked cases** (hypothetical dates)

1. Structural Blueprint Estimate checked in on 4 May and written on 10 May: 6 calendar days, less 3 turnaround business days, is a lateness of 3 days — at least 2 but under 4 — adding 1 free storage day.
2. Blueprint Teardown Estimate checked in on 4 May and written on 10 May: 6 calendar days, less 2, is a lateness of 4 days — adding 3 free storage days.
3. Blueprint Teardown Estimate checked in on 4 May and written on 7 May: 3 calendar days, less 2, is a lateness of 1 day — nothing added.
